name: Notify Aim
author: Uddeshya Maurya

sections.description:
Notify Aim is a simple yet powerful push notification plugin for WordPress.
It allows you to send real-time web push notifications directly to your users’ browsers, desktops, and mobile devices without requiring complex setup.

✨ Features:
– Easy integration with your WordPress site
– Real-time web push notifications
– Customizable prompts for subscribers
– Segment users by topics and interests
– Works with blogs, e-commerce, news sites, and more
– Lightweight SDK with fast delivery

Why use Notify Aim?
Unlike traditional email or SMS, push notifications are instant and highly engaging. With Notify Aim, you can improve user engagement, boost sales, and keep your audience coming back — all without extra effort.

🚀 Perfect for: bloggers, e-commerce stores, news websites, SaaS apps, and anyone who wants to connect with their users instantly.

External Services

This plugin connects to the external service “Notify Aim” (https://notifyaim.com) to deliver push notifications to website visitors.

What the service is and what it is used for

Notify Aim is a push notification delivery platform. The plugin connects to the Notify Aim API to:
– Load the JavaScript SDK required to manage subscriptions in visitor browsers.
– Send notifications from the site owner to subscribers.

What data is sent and when

  • When a visitor subscribes, their browser/device subscription data (push token, user agent, and related metadata) is sent to the Notify Aim servers in order to deliver notifications.
  • When the site owner sends a notification, the notification content (title, message, target URL) is transmitted to Notify Aim’s API, which then delivers the message to subscriber devices.
  • API requests are sent securely via HTTPS.

Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

  • Terms of Service: https://notifyaim.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://notifyaim.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/notify-aim directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure your public/private keys in Settings → Notify Aim.
sections.faq:
Does this work on all browsers?

Yes, it works on all browsers that support Web Push.

Do I need an API key?

Yes, you must create a free account at Notify Aim to get your keys.

Do I need a third-party account to use this plugin?

Nope! Notify Aim works out-of-the-box with your WordPress site. However, it connects to our secure Notify Aim service to deliver notifications efficiently.

Which websites can I use Notify Aim on?

You can use it on blogs, e-commerce stores, news websites, SaaS apps, and basically any WordPress site where you want to engage users in real-time.

Can I customize the notification prompt?

Yes! Notify Aim allows you to customize the prompt text, buttons, and behavior to match your website’s style and user experience.

Does this plugin work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! Notify Aim supports all modern browsers and mobile devices, delivering push notifications even on smartphones and tablets.
